budget_derivation.I/O_costs: logical/serialized bytes, synchronized wall and dispatch wall are recorded separately; physical I/O is unmeasured
budget_derivation.artifact_accounting: 194 MiB reserved = 96 MiB audit/store/receipt/log envelope + 2 MiB teacher cache + 96 MiB two-site extension/optimizer checkpoint. Checkpoint arithmetic: 4.22M trainable float32 parameters (2.90M reader + 1.32M compressor) plus two AdamW moment buffers; this is a bound, not a fit measurement
budget_derivation.artifact_read_accounting: 44627834537 declared file-read bytes: 8238996247 of source hashing per process admission/worker and the same again for each weight load (2x in load and 2x in restart), 450061586 of environment-closure hashing in admission, load and restart, and the checkpoint plus teacher cache at restart. Physical page-cache reuse is not measured and is not subtracted
budget_derivation.audit_io: append-only journal: logical appended bytes equal appended bytes; physical SSD amplification and flush cost are not measured and are not claimed to be lower than v11. Lower audit cost is not better learning
budget_derivation.backbone_token_unit: each decode/parity forward reserves forwards=1 and input_tokens=256 (fixed right-padded context width)
budget_derivation.baseline_forwards: 8 worlds * 8 reserved tokens = 64; no source features
budget_derivation.basis: every stage is re-derived from the v12 mechanism, not projected from the v11 totals; all counts are worst-case reservations and none is refunded
budget_derivation.correction_forwards: 24 generated + 1 source forward; 2 tokenizer passes because the correction evicts the corrected record before the re-read
budget_derivation.deadline: monotonic and wall-clock outer deadline both persisted; the stricter remaining time wins, so a monotonic-clock restart cannot extend the budget
budget_derivation.fit_probe_forwards: per prefix, 32 worlds * (2 parity + 6 control + 6*8 generated) = 1792 backbone forwards, plus 96 source forwards; per world 4 tokenizer passes (release rebuild, provenance re-check after publication cleared C, live, wrong-world), 4 release writes, 3 descriptor writes and 2 of resume headroom; plus 2 stage receipts
budget_derivation.fitting_updates: 32 worlds * 16 passes = 512; each update reserves 1 backbone forward, 1 canonical span, 1 backward, 1 update and 1 receipt write
budget_derivation.prepare_forwards: 32 admissions * 1 canonical span = 32; 32 retrievals; per world one declared admission write, three descriptor writes for the read, and two of resume headroom
budget_derivation.read_descriptor_writes: a successful wait-based read persists three pending descriptors (initial pending, dispatch reservation, terminal); a waiting read that times out persists two; a read whose own dispatch fails persists three. Three is therefore the exact unconditional bound and every stage reserves 3 per read. Each explicit bounded caller resume persists at most two (one when it attaches to an in-flight ticket, none when refused before dispatch), so 2 of resume headroom is reserved per read. The read's own internal resume is inside that 3 and is not charged again. There is no automatic retry: at most four caller waits, then a typed refusal
budget_derivation.restart_forwards: 2 canary/update backbone forwards + 2 source spans recomputed from a cleared feature cache; 1 backward, 1 update, 1 model load, 2 restores (checkpoint and teacher cache) and their read bytes
budget_derivation.restart_prompt_tokenization: restart reserves 67 prompt-tokenizer passes = 64 (2 encodings for each of 32 restored teacher targets: student and exact text) + 1 (canary encoding) + 2 (continuation student encoding and the exact-text encoding that the alignment binding re-derives). Nothing else in the restart path tokenizes a prompt
budget_derivation.source_span_unit: one cache-missing canonical span reserves tokenizer_calls=1, source_encodes=1, source_token_bytes=256 and input_tokens=256 for the tokenizer, then forwards=1, source_feature_forwards=1, cache_misses/evictions/recomputations=1 and input_tokens=256 for the frozen source forward
budget_derivation.stage_wall: sum of all 22 two-site stage caps: admission=30 + load=180 + capacity_main=15 + capacity_restart=15 + finalize_parent=20 + finalize_worker=30 + baseline=45 + numerical=30 + prepare=60 + teacher=90 + checkpoint=60 + development=540 + correction=60 + restart=150 + fit_128=500 + fit_probes_128=900 + fit_256=500 + fit_probes_256=900 + fit_384=500 + fit_probes_384=900 + fit_512=500 + fit_probes_512=900 = 6925 seconds inside the 7200-second whole-process-group envelope; the remaining 275 seconds are outer headroom, never a stage allowance
budget_derivation.teacher_forwards: 32 answers * 8 reserved tokens + 32 target forwards = 288; no source features
budget_derivation.total_forwards: 64 + 3 + 32 + 288 + 4*256 + 4*1888 + 2 + 784 + 25 + 4 = 9778; a source forward appears twice on purpose: once as a frozen backbone forward (forwards) and once as source_feature_forwards, because v12 dispatches both
budget_derivation.total_writes: sum of all 22 two-site stage caps: admission=2 + load=1 + capacity_main=1 + capacity_restart=1 + finalize_parent=2 + finalize_worker=2 + baseline=9 + numerical=2 + prepare=385 + teacher=34 + checkpoint=7 + development=194 + correction=26 + restart=13 + fit_128=129 + fit_probes_128=483 + fit_256=129 + fit_probes_256=483 + fit_384=129 + fit_probes_384=483 + fit_512=129 + fit_probes_512=484 = 3128 declared writes, including descriptor persists, one observed source-cost receipt per closed stage, and the receipts written outside a stage

differences_from_v11: value_producer: frozen canonical-source decoder hidden states followed by a live trainable compressor instead of a trainable encoder over template-framed text
source_input: canonical span text only, no chat template and no special tokens, explicit zero-based positions, extensions disabled and audited
feature_cache: bounded 32 MiB / 64 entry in-process C that is never serialized
slots: four ordered 256-wide slots per admitted span, learned order added exactly once by the v12 snapshot path

work_ledger: append-only replica.intrinsic_memory.reservations.v12 journal with source-feature, canonical-source tokenizer, prompt tokenizer, cache and restart vocabulary, and dual monotonic/wall deadlines

stage_budget: re-derived per-stage allocation (500 s per fit segment, 900 s per probe, plus two declared terminal-receipt stages and two capacity-guard stages) instead of the inherited 7080 s; the authoritative total is stage_wall_value, computed from the caps

checkpoint: v12 complete extension plus optimizer with bound feature, adapter, tokenizer and layout contracts, the complete representation release, an explicit release alias and the compressor-only release; no v11 checkpoint is migrated
teacher_cache: v12 format bound to the source-feature contract, adapter contract and tokenizer contract
slot_policy_declaration: slot_policy_v12 added next to the inherited fixed_eight_masked_padding_v5 field required by the sealed validators

release_corpus: replica.contextual_producer_release.v12 namespace, now publishing the complete representation release (producer, order, reader and feature contract), so any contextual-path update invalidates previously durable values
restart: source features are recomputed from a cleared cache; the recomputed feature contract and adapter content binding are compared with the checkpoint before mutation
adapter_contract: content-bound through the already-verified full original parameter digest, so an adapter with identical geometry but different content is refused
data_manifest: new v12 manifest with an explicit exposure contract over the same rows
